definitions.explanation: The period at the end of the calendar year, especially December. Often used in commercial and seasonal contexts.

examples.japanese: {歳末|さいまつ}⟦セール→セール：07780_seeru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
{歳末|さいまつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{買|か}い{物客|ものきゃく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{賑|にぎ}わう→賑わう：14235_nigiwau⟧。
examples.english: At year-end, the streets bustle with shoppers.

examples.japanese: {歳末|さいまつ}⟦{助|たす}け{合|あ}い→助け合い：16991_tasukeai⟧⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{寄付|きふ}→寄付：02584_kifu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I donated to the year-end charity drive.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal word for the year-end period, commonly seen in advertising, news, and seasonal greetings. More formal than ⟦{年末|ねんまつ}→年末：17688_nenmatsu⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {歳末|さいまつ}⟦セール→セール：07780_seeru⟧ (year-end sale)
- {歳末|さいまつ}{大売出|おおうりだ}し (year-end grand sale)
- {歳末|さいまつ}⟦{助|たす}け{合|あ}い→助け合い：16991_tasukeai⟧ (year-end mutual aid / charity drive)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{歳末|さいまつ} is more formal and commercial than ⟦{年末|ねんまつ}→年末：17688_nenmatsu⟧, which is the everyday word for "year-end." {歳末|さいまつ} is especially common in retail and charitable contexts.
